annotation.title_clean: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.title_en: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI); Center for Strategic Studies and Management (CGEE)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's national AI plan (PBIA) by MCTI and CGEE sets out an investment-backed strategy for sovereign AI infrastructure, training, public-service AI, business innovation and support for regulation and governance. It frames 'AI for the Good of All' around inclusive, sustainable development, with no meaningful robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five structuring axes: infrastructure and development, diffusion and training, public service, business innovation, regulatory and governance support
Immediate impact actions plus structuring actions with an investment amount
Programs for AI literacy, education, and workforce qualification
Governance and monitoring arrangements overseen by the National Council for Science and Technology
Emphasis on technological sovereignty, sustainability and social welfare
